proof.command: $TMPDIR/i168/g7/run.sh L<i>-<mode> <mode> for i in 1..11, both modes in parallel, 03:18:23Z-03:20:17Z; each session runs a no-change `dispatch ask --issue INFRA-814 …` (refused by the rules check), resends it with --advisor-rebuttal, retracts the ask. Then per session: the advisor-gate entries' toolCallIds against `dispatch doc-read --project INFRA --artifact askgate-decisions-<session>-md` ids; `bun packages/pi-envoy/scripts/askgate-report.ts --dispatch-project INFRA --since 2026-10-30T03:18:23Z` and `--sessions $TMPDIR/i168/g7/sessions --since … --sample 0`.

trickyParts: A record write now has no stop of its own: it runs under the client's keyed retries (one Idempotency-Key per call) until Dispatch answers or the shutdown cut, 1,250 ms after shutdown begins, ends it. A record still lost is counted from the session file (`decision records lost`), and a copy Dispatch stored anyway is dropped by the reader on (session, id) and counted as `duplicate records`.
An unmarked write's record id is `<toolCallId>#<line>`, since one tool call can log several writes in the CLI ledger.
abandoned()'s throw on "timeout" has no test: that state is unreachable from the public API.
